systems.platform: MOSIP, with Integrated Biometrics fingerprint capture devices

note: The webinar names Zambia once, as one of three countries (with Ethiopia and Niger) where Integrated Biometrics says its devices were recently used in MOSIP pilots; MOSIP is described as a platform for identity issuance and verification. Nothing is stated about civil registration in Zambia; the civil registry discussion concerns Ethiopia.
